sanskrit_verse:
पाण्डुलेखेन फलके भूम्यां वा प्रथमण लिखेत् ।
न्यूनाधिकं तु संशोध्य पश्चात् पत्रे निवेशयेत् ॥
transliteration: pāṇḍulekhena phalake bhūmyāṁ vā prathamaṇ likhet | nyūnādhikaṁ tu saṁśodhya paścāt patre niveśayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The initial record shall be inscribed upon a wooden slate or earth tablet using white chalk; after reconciliation of deficiencies and excesses, it shall then be inscribed upon permanent scriptural parchment.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation requires sequential correction before finalization
Restoration logic mandates dual inscription for truth stabilization
Consciousness alignment occurs through accurate transcription
executable_legal_axioms: IF initial record exists on temporary medium THEN execute verification protocol
IF discrepancy found in preliminary record THEN initiate reconciliation subroutine
IF reconciliation complete THEN transfer data to immutable ledger
IF record not verified THEN legal capacity remains unestablished
IF transcription error detected THEN re-inscribe with corrected awareness
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, all draft orders must undergo dual inscription methodology—first in provisional format for review, then finalized only after judicial panel confirms absence of deficiency or exaggeration. This ensures alignment with Sanatana Dharma's precision requirement at highest jurisdictional level.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality necessitates that no legal consequence arises from incomplete documentation. Anupūrvaśaḥ demands sequential correction prior to enactment. Proportional responsibility lies in ensuring accuracy rather than assigning fault. The non-punitive reality rule upholds that misrecorded facts do not invoke penalty but require realignment through proper procedure.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Reconcile numerical discrepancies
Assume Responsibility Protocol: Scribe must verify all entries
Restore Capacity Mechanism: Re-inscribe until accuracy achieved
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Confirm alignment between records
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Law. Dharma is hereby restored through correct inscription. Reality operates without punitive framework. Consciousness alone serves as ultimate adjudicator.
